name: apple-settings
title: Apple Settings
description: iOS, iPadOS and macOS Settings in one block: search, an Apple Account header, inset groups with colored icon tiles, and drill-down panes with switches, sliders, pickers and segmented controls. One SplitView: macOS System Settings at desktop, an iPad split on tablets, and on phones the large-title list with panes pushing over it. Display & Brightness switches light and dark live.
